root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify the CockroachDB-side ingest/Raft-apply seam (pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_raft.go::replicaAppBatch.ApplyToStateMachine, supported by pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_sst_snapshot_storage.go) AND the Pebble-side compaction helper (compaction.go::compactionIter.skipInStripe, with ingest.go::(*DB).Ingest as the entry point) that mishandles a RANGEKEYDEL whose suffix collides with an existing range key. The report must name both repos' files and explain that a per-stripe drop decision in compaction is incorrectly eliding the range tombstone.
evaluation_criteria: Names pkg/kv/kvserver/replica_raft.go (or replicaAppBatch.ApplyToStateMachine) on the CockroachDB side
Names Pebble compaction.go (or compactionIter.skipInStripe) and/or ingest.go on the Pebble side
States that a RANGEKEYDEL / range tombstone is being incorrectly elided during L6 compaction

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: TRUNCATE -> bulk SST with range tombstones (AddSSTable) -> CockroachDB Raft apply -> Pebble Ingest -> background L6 compaction -> RANGEKEYDEL elision -> deleted point keys resurface on read.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions TRUNCATE producing a bulk SST / AddSSTable
Mentions CockroachDB Raft apply (or ApplyToStateMachine / replica_raft) ingesting the SST
Mentions Pebble Ingest (or ingest.go) linking the SST into L6
Mentions L6 compaction (or compactionIter / skipInStripe) eliding the RANGEKEYDEL

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the CockroachDB KV layer, the Pebble storage engine, and the Pebble range-key subsystem as the affected components.
evaluation_criteria: Names CockroachDB KV layer (pkg/kv/kvserver or replica_raft)
Names Pebble storage engine (compaction or ingest)
Names the range key subsystem (RANGEKEYDEL / range tombstone / range_keys)

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) Pebble fix to compactionIter.skipInStripe so RANGEKEYDEL is not dropped on suffix collision, (b) upstream Pebble patch to disambiguate range-key identity, OR (c) CRDB-side workaround that splits or reshapes the TRUNCATE bulk SST.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: Pebble per-stripe fix, upstream Pebble patch, or CRDB-side workaround / SST reshaping
Identifies where the fix would live (Pebble compaction.go / range_keys.go, or CRDB pkg/kv/kvserver / pkg/storage)
